name: United Drilling Tools Ltd
tagline: Small oilfield-tooling maker (casing connectors, downhole tools, gas-lift equipment) with a ~1.3-yr order backlog and improving margins — but low ROE, a small niche, and only a documented 'study', not a call
business_overview: Manufacturer of large-OD multi-start casing connectors and casing pipes, wireline winches, artificial gas-lift equipment, downhole tools and high-performance connectors for the oil, gas and drilling industries; some export traction.
fundamentals_table: PAT ~Rs 4.2-4.3 Cr (+42-46% YoY); total income ~Rs 34.6 Cr (+7%)
fundamentals_narrative: Profit is growing faster than revenue (PAT +26% FY26, +42-46% in Q1 FY27) on margin/mix, and the ~Rs 244 Cr backlog gives a little over a year of revenue visibility; the balance sheet is clean and it pays a dividend. But returns are low (5-8% ROE/ROCE), revenue growth is mid-single-digit, the addressable niche is small (Indian upstream capex is roughly flat), and new orders disclosed are tiny (Rs 0.5 Cr gas-lift mandrels, Rs 3 Cr Nigeria export). At ~24x earnings for a low-ROE, slow-growth business it is not cheap.
